album.album: A Tapestry of Souls: Dawn of Ravenspire
album.AlbumPlot:
### "A Tapestry of Souls: Dawn of Ravenspire" — The 0 GD Trilogy, Part III (Era II)
[One-paragraph arc: Anya's resolve, the last charge, the ritual, the farewell, the seal, Nyktoros's rage, the vigil, Seraphina rallying the survivors, the exodus over the Great Rift, and the vow at the dawn. To be expanded by the sibling plan.]
